text.p: Manchester United of England beat Porto of Portugal 4-0 (halftime 2-0) in their European cup quarter-final first leg match on Wednesday.
Scorers - David May 22, Eric Cantona 34, Ryan Giggs 61, Andy Cole 80

Manchester United - 1-Peter Schmeichel; 2-Gary Neville, 4-David May, 6-Gary Pallister, 3-Denis Irwin, 10-David Beckham, 5-Ronny Johnsen, 11-Ryan Giggs, 7-Eric Cantona, 9-Andy Cole, 20-Ole Gunnar Solskjaer.

Porto - 24-Hilario; 7-Sergio Conceicao, 22-Jorge Costa, 4-Aloisio, 20-Paulhino Santos, 17-Barroso, 23-Costa (16-Jardel 25), 25-Zlatko Zahovic, 21-Edmilson, 14-Artur (8-Rui Barros 46), 11-Ljubinko Drulovic.
